title: Approved refunds
instruction: Two of my refunds were approved, but I'm not sure the money arrived. Follow up on any that are late, and only close a refund case once the money is actually in my account.

documents.title: Corvid Audio: refund approved
documents.text:

documents.title: Pinefield Home: refund approved
documents.text:
Pinefield Home - refund approved
Date: October 10, 2026
Return case case-pf-552    Order PF-7718
Refund amount: $95.00 to your Visa ending 2086, expected by October 15, 2026.
Status: Processed.

rules: Pinefield's $95.00 refund posts to visa-2086 on 2026-10-14 (transaction tx-8150).
Corvid's $140.00 refund does not post unless the case is escalated.

escalate_case on case-cv-118 before 2026-10-16 is rejected with reason 'premature'. On 2026-10-16 or 2026-10-17 it is accepted and $140.00 posts to debit-7734 on 2026-10-18 (transaction tx-8171). After 2026-10-17 it is accepted but the credit posts after the horizon. Nothing happens on 2026-10-16 by itself, so an agent reaches it with advance_time(until).
escalate_case on case-pf-552 is accepted and answered with 'refund already settled'.
request_refund on either case is declined as a duplicate. open_dispute is accepted by the card issuer and recorded.

case-cv-118.reply: Corvid Audio: we found the problem and resent your $140.00 refund. It will post on October 18.
case-cv-118.late_reply: Corvid Audio: we have resent your refund. Allow 7-10 business days for it to post.

case-pf-552.reply: Pinefield Home: our records show this refund already settled.

annotations.paired_variant: Corvid's credit posts on 2026-10-14; the correct run then escalates nothing.

args.note: Refund promised by Oct 15 has not arrived.
